newsitem.title: KUWAIT: Kuwait premier to fly to U.S. for medical checks.
newsitem.headline: Kuwait premier to fly to U.S. for medical checks.

text.p: Kuwait's Crown Prince and Prime Minister Sheikh Saad al-Abdulla al-Sabah, recovering in London from colon surgery, will fly on Sunday to the United States for medical checks at the Mayo Clinic, Kuwaiti newspapers said.
They said Sheikh Saad, born in 1930, planned to spend an unspecified period of time in the United States after his medical checkup. He had been scheduled to go to Rome from London this month.

Sheikh Saad, whose Gulf Arab state controls 10 percent of the world's proven oil reserves, had emergency colon surgery in Kuwait in early march. He flew to London a few days later on board a medical aircraft supplied by Saudi Arabian King Fahd for followup treatment.
Veteran Foreign Minister Sheikh Sabah al-Ahmad al-Sabah is running Kuwait's government as acting prime minister. Sheikh Saad has been prime minister and heir apparent since 1978.
